evidence.claim: Gordan 1868, Crelle, DOI 10.1515/crll.1868.69.323
Gordan is the leading expert on invariant theory; Hilbert's 1888 basis theorem was submitted for his opinion

milestones.note: Finiteness for binary forms; the page range is as usually cited and was not verified.

milestones.label: Hilbert's basis theorem
milestones.work: Hilbert, Ueber die Theorie der algebraischen Formen, Math. Ann. 36 (1890)
milestones.description: Hilbert proves the finite basis theorem for invariants of general forms, a non-constructive finiteness result.

evidence.claim: Hilbert 1890, Math. Ann., DOI 10.1007/bf01208503
In 1888 Hilbert proved the finite basis theorem, with an existence proof only

milestones.note: The 1888 basis theorem is in the history; the 1890 paper is the bibliographic record used here.

milestones.label: Hilbert's orbit separation criterion
milestones.work: Hilbert, Ueber die vollen Invariantensysteme, Math. Ann. 42 (1893)
milestones.description: Hilbert formulates and proves a criterion for orbits that cannot be separated, the quotient-theoretic insight behind GIT.

evidence.claim: Hilbert 1893 criterion for orbits that are not separated
Hilbert 1893, Math. Ann., DOI 10.1007/bf01444162

milestones.note: The criterion is from the Wikipedia summary; the paper's text was not checked.

milestones.label: Mumford's quotient construction
milestones.work: Mumford, Geometric Invariant Theory, Springer, Ergebnisse 34 (1965)
milestones.description: Mumford constructs quotients of varieties by group actions, giving moduli spaces of curves and bundles.

evidence.claim: Mumford, Geometric Invariant Theory, Springer 1965, DOI 10.1007/978-3-662-00095-3
Geometric invariant theory was founded and developed by Mumford in a monograph first published in 1965

milestones.label: 'Geometric invariant theory' in the monograph title
milestones.work: Mumford, Geometric Invariant Theory (1965) (as above)
milestones.description: The monograph's title gives the theory its name.

evidence.claim: Title 'Geometric Invariant Theory', Springer 1965

milestones.note: Same work as the first_statement; recorded under both roles (rule 2).
